Where is Tongson Bay? | On Koh Samui's north-east coast, between Choeng Mon and the Plai Laem headland, at about 9.5866, 100.0757. It is 10–15 minutes from the airport and about 15–20 minutes from central Chaweng.
Can you swim at Tongson Bay? | Yes, especially from December to April, when the water is clear, shallow and calm. The north end has the better sandy bottom; the south end is rocky and better for snorkelling. There are no lifeguards, so stay out when waves are breaking or a red flag is up.
Can I drive a scooter to Tongson Bay? | Yes, with care. The last stretch is a sand and dirt track that is manageable when dry but slippery and rutted after rain. Inexperienced riders should take a Grab or taxi and arrange the return in advance.
When is Tongson Bay best? | From December to April, and best of all from February to April when the sea is calmest. From May to October it is rougher, and in the October–November monsoon it is often too choppy for a good swim.
Are there facilities at Tongson Bay? | Very few. Thongson Bay Restaurant has loungers for customers, but there are no public toilets, showers, shops or lifeguards. Bring water, sunscreen, snacks and cash; the nearest shops are 5–10 minutes away at Choeng Mon.
Is Tongson Bay good for snorkelling? | It is modest but pleasant around the rocks at the southern end of the bay: small reef fish, urchins and some coral, best on a calm morning from December to April. There is no rental, so bring a mask and water shoes. For real reefs, Koh Tan on the Pig Island trip is far better.
